mapper.select: SELECT execution_row.* FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row WHERE execution_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND execution_row.source_package_id IN #{id} AND execution_row.execution_status <> #{draftStatus} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_group_execution newer WHERE newer.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id AND newer.task_id = execution_row.task_id AND newer.seq = execution_row.seq AND newer.attempt_no > execution_row.attempt_no ) ORDER BY execution_row.id FOR UPDATE
